correctness.rationale: An exact first-return renewal identity gives \(R(s)_{ii}=\{1+r_i\mathbb E[s(1-e^{-T_i/s})]\}^{-1}\) including defective returns. Each integrand is strictly increasing for \(T_i>0\) (even infinity), so resolvent diagonal is strictly decreasing from 1 to its recurrence-dependent endpoint. The theta Cayley identity gives automatic nonnegative offdiagonals and exact diagonal crossing criteria for all finite Q. Endpoint 0 and theta=0 are separate. Renewal-reward proves class stationary masses; time reversal preserves diagonal resolvents. The actual standalone verify.py passed 197 exact-rational generators; finite replay is not treated as an all-generator proof.

value.rationale: Exact positivity-time topology for every finite nonreversible or reducible Markov generator removes a substantive limitation of the closest reversible literature and prevents incorrect extrapolation from potentially oscillatory raw return probabilities. Classifies unconditional steps using transience and class stationary mass, and proves robust time-reversal equality. This is a structural theorem for a standard integrator family, not a routine isolated arithmetic invariant.
